blocks.title: Software as a Service (SaaS)
blocks.text: SaaS provider ki host aur manage ki hui software applications deta hai; users subscribe kar ke internet par istemal karte hain, na hardware sambhalna na software updates install karna.

Google Workspace (pehle G Suite) mein Gmail, Google Docs aur Google Drive hain; Microsoft Office 365 aur Salesforce doosri misalein hain. Kitab batati hai ke Salesforce customer relationship management (CRM) ka bara SaaS provider hai jise 150,000 se zyada companies istemal karti hain, aur cloud services ki qeemat istemal par hoti hai, pay as you go (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Chapter mein di gayi cloud services mein kaunsi NAHI: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS ya BaaS (MCQ 5)?
blocks.explanation: (d) Blockchain as a Service (BaaS) sikhayi gayi teen bari qismon mein nahi, agarche kuch providers yeh dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: AWS, Azure ya Google Cloud jaise cloud provider par tehqeeq kar ke asal duniya ka ek istemal bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Maslan company apni website AWS ke virtual servers (IaaS) par host kar sakti, backups cloud storage mein rakh sakti, aur staff ko Gmail aur Google Docs (SaaS) istemal karwa sakti hai; students provider, service ki qism aur kya bachta hai pesh karein.

items: SaaS: internet par tayyar software (Gmail, Office 365, Salesforce).
